column1: # Differential-correctness corpus for GNU coreutils 9.5 (Phoenix Pi4 vs host-GNU).
#   - token-string is split on single spaces to form argv (matches psh strtok(" \t")).
#   - first token is the coreutils tool name (no path); harness prefixes /usr/bin/ for Pi,
#   - @F:<name> expands to /root/cutest/<name> on the Pi and to <name> (cwd=corpus) on host.
#   - NO quotes / NO shell metachars: psh does not process them, so neither may we.
#   - printf backslash-escapes (\n) are literal 2-char tokens; printf itself interprets them.
# pilot column: cases marked "pilot" run in the small first cycle.
